execution: the release record still links the bound source
the blocklist entry is recorded so it can be removed
the executor allocates and names the isolated copy
the copy does not overwrite an existing file (no-overwrite)
the copy is validated against the stated client
not_prerequisites: a destination name from the model
a clean full decode of the source

execution: the destination slot is still free at execution time (collision check)
no file is overwritten or deleted
the new name does not collide with another file
the old value is recorded for the undo

amendments.text: H1 counts only integrity-kind results (never integrity_signal such as audio levels) and needs a positively clean result at the container or package level; a clean decode window extends the checked scope but never stands alone
amendments.why: v3.0 H1 accepted a lone decode window while M1 required a container or package level result; the two are reconciled on the stricter reading

amendments.text: H5: no other class is established (all of its diagnosis prerequisites met); an established actionable diagnosis, for example an unsupported selected stream for the stated client, excludes healthy
amendments.why: v3.0 let an established decoder incompatibility satisfy every healthy prerequisite at once

amendments.text: an evidence_method that is negated or says the observation was not made, failed or was unavailable (no, not, without, unavailable, failed, missing, none, never, cannot, could not, unable, skipped) is report_unknown, whatever other words it holds
amendments.why: methods such as "no OCR performed" were promoted to report_content

amendments.text: a prerequisite is supported only by results that ran to completion (state ran, status ok) or by the case context; the only exceptions are D-COR-1 (the positive findings of a partial or timed-out result, inside their scope) and A-BLK-3 (an error result whose cause is not tool and that carries a located defect)
amendments.why: partial OCR and partial / error / timeout catalog records supported identity and source binding

amendments.text: identity is compared ATTRIBUTE BY ATTRIBUTE (title, episode number, episode title, author, language, year); a content observation settles only the attributes it speaks to, so a declared disagreement on an attribute no content addresses stays contested; list-valued declarations are compared element by element; language is compared by primary subtag with a fixed ISO 639-1 / 639-2 table
amendments.why: a matching OCR title erased an unsettled year disagreement; list-valued EPUB titles and creators and a wrong language were ignored

amendments.text: a typed field (not free text) also agrees when it is a run of two or more tokens of a catalog name; a one-word fragment never agrees
amendments.why: the checker carried this exception without a rubric statement (review of d25e7e92)

amendments.text: a case-supplied choice settles candidates only when it names a listed candidate; context.expected.edition counts as a case-supplied wanted edition

the destination slot is free only when every shown complete record of the destination agrees that no file is linked; free and occupied records that disagree leave the slot unresolved; a content observation naming two different other items leaves the destination unresolved
amendments.why: the result depended on which record id sorted first

amendments.text: a write needs its class's diagnosis prerequisites AND its action prerequisites; every cited reference must qualify for its role (source.ref and a release target are a record that binds the source; slot_ref and slot_free_ref are destination records); a rename's old_value equals a visible current naming-surface value and its new_value agrees with the catalog on every attribute it speaks to
amendments.why: the damage observation could serve as the source binding, unseen rename values passed, and a rename stood with its diagnosis unmet

amendments.text: a rename's old_value is the LITERAL current value (no case, punctuation or spacing change); its new_value is an evidenced naming operation: a basename only (no path component, no surrounding whitespace), the same file extension, every word token taken from visible facts (the catalog, complete catalog records, the current names, the catalog's episode markers), and agreement with the catalog
amendments.why: a case- or punctuation-altered unseen old name passed, and an invented directory prefix passed every prerequisite (AUDIT-ASTRA-18)

amendments.changes: eligibility of derived comparisons; M5, M8
amendments.text: a derived comparison that supports a prerequisite (the client comparison of D-DEC-2 and A-CNV-2) is computed from complete results only; an incomplete result that contradicts (an attribute that disagrees with the catalog, an unsupported client field) is material uncertainty (M5, M8): it blocks healthy and supports nothing
amendments.why: a partial probe established incompatibility, and a partial OCR naming another episode was discarded so healthy passed (AUDIT-ASTRA-18)

amendments.text: a value that asserts several episode markers agrees on the episode only when EVERY marker is the target's; any contradicting marker is a disagreement; a rename's new value may not reuse a marker-shaped token (SxxEyy, NxNN) that is not the target's own, from the wrong current name or any other source
amendments.why: a new name carrying the right and the wrong marker together met every prerequisite (AUDIT-ASTRA-19)

amendments.text: each part of a multi-part audiobook is a naming-surface source: every part tag is checked for explicit emptiness; a part's album and artist are compared with the catalog like the container tags (M5 identity, M6 naming); only a part's title, which is a chapter name, is exempt from that comparison
amendments.why: an emptiness-only check let every part's album name another book while healthy passed; a title-to-book comparison flagged every chapter name (the Opus review of 2355220b, the advisory review of e4448c07)

declaration_disagreement.value: a declared identity / edition value that disagrees with the catalog

destination_evidenced.value: content names the item the file really is, and the catalog lists that item

free_slot.value: a catalog record of the destination item shows NO linked file (explicit null / empty / hasFile false); absent is not evidence

identity_agreement.value: a content value that contains a catalog identity value (title, alias, episode title or marker)

identity_disagreement.value: a typed title / episode / author / language field, or an episode marker in text, that disagrees with every catalog value after aliases and orderings

located_defect.value: a finding with known_defect true and a location

managed_app.value: context.arr.app is a managing app (sonarr, radarr, lidarr, readarr, bookshelf, lazylibrarian)

naming_surface_defect.value: M6: an explicitly empty, or differing, naming-surface field (absent is NOT evidence: it is unknown)

new_value.value: the catalog value the naming surface should carry, populated and different from the old value

no_settling_choice.value: no case-supplied choice (series_order, library_episode_order, wanted / monitored edition) that selects one candidate

source_bound.value: the managing app's record of the linked file (relativePath / file id) equals the case's file name or file id; for an unmanaged item the case item itself

support_grade_defect.value: located_defect from a result that ran to completion (state ran, status ok), or an error result whose cause is not tool

two_candidates.value: two or more legitimate candidates listed by the case (editions, episode orders, aliases with different numbering)

unsupported_selected_stream.value: client_comparison row unsupported, selection recorded or only_stream_of_type

insufficient_evidence.value: no other class established and healthy not established

metadata_naming.value: uncontradicted or content_verified (contested or contradicted is not naming)

healthy.text: a positively clean integrity-kind result at the container or package level (A31-1)
no known_defect finding and no collector veto in any shown result, of any execution state
no material uncertainty M1 to M9
identity is uncontradicted (no M5); positive content confirmation of identity is NOT required for none, which changes nothing

identity_levels.content_verified: a content or report_content observation agrees with the catalog on an identity attribute and nothing contradicts it
identity_levels.contested: only declarations, report_declaration or report_hash disagree with the catalog; no content observation settles it
identity_levels.contradicted_by_content: a content or report_content observation disagrees with the catalog on an identity or edition attribute
identity_levels.uncontradicted: nothing disagrees with the catalog, and no content observation confirms it

link_rules.meaning: may inspect this scope; never will resolve it
link_rules.offsets: every advertised offset whose window intersects the unresolved interval, in advertised order; "any" yields one template at the interval start; never an offset chosen by a recorded result

material_uncertainty.text: no positively clean integrity result exists at the item's container or package level (every one failed, timed out, was unavailable, was unknown or was not made)

an unclassified diagnostic (a finding kind ending _unclassified, probe_messages, input_failure, exit_nonzero_unclassified) inside a checked scope; a decoder_warning alone is not material and is not clean
a material conflict (MATERIAL_CONFLICTS) in any shown result

a signal that points INTO the unchecked remainder: a container duration that disagrees with the catalog runtime beyond tolerance, a decoded span shorter than the container duration, or a complaint (context.question) that names a part that was not checked

an identity or edition attribute of any declaration, content or report that disagrees with the catalog (after the case-supplied aliases, alternate titles, editions and orderings are applied) and is not settled by a content observation
a naming-surface declaration of this media type that is explicitly empty, or that differs from the catalog value
two legitimate candidates (orderings, numberings or editions listed by the case) that the observations fit, with no case-supplied choice that settles them
a stated client with an unknown verdict, an unread clause, or an ambiguous or unrecorded stream selection for a field it states
a complaint (context.question) whose subject no shown observation reaches

uncalled_rules: not a repeat of a call already made
not a repeat of a call that failed, timed out or was unavailable
